Batch scrape with aggressive preprocessing configuration

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { batchScrape, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { content: { preprocessingPreset: "aggressive" } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const urls = ["https://example.com/article1", "https://example.com/article2"];
  const result = await batchScrape(engine, urls);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
